changelog:
- Tightened input requirements: now requires a work link or pasted comment text; no blind category scans allowed unless user specifies.
- Clarified that every quote or hook in the brief must point to an original source comment.
- Updated grouping and brief instructions: objections, FAQs, verbatim lines, and pain points are grouped, with hooks derived directly from user quotes.
- Improved confirmation and attribution requirements for all looked-up data.
- Removed the unused file skill-card.md.
summary: Turn public comments into a usable brief. Give a post link, a category to search, or comments you already copied, and get the objections, verbatim lines, purchase worries, FAQ answers, live-commerce replies, and spoken hooks that come from what viewers actually wrote. This comment analysis workflow reads public comments on Douyin, TikTok, Xiaohongshu, Instagram, YouTube, and X, and reply threads on Douyin, TikTok, Xiaohongshu, Instagram, and YouTube, or works from comments you paste, then groups the real audience language into a same-day brief. Use it for comment analysis, comment-section analysis, comment mining, VOC insight, audience insight, user voice research, FAQ writing, and live-commerce answers that sound like the audience.
